_about: Benedict de Spinoza (1632-1677) in English, translator per row, raw IA OCR. Elwes's translations are lane C's (elwes shelf: the Theologico-Political Treatise and the Improvement of the Understanding) and his Ethics is on the Adler shelf (PG 3800); none is taken again here, nor the Bohn Chief Works. Here: William Hale White's Ethic (Trübner, 1883), Robert Willis's Tractatus Theologico-Politicus (Trübner, 1862) and Benedict de Spinoza: his life, correspondence, and Ethics (Trübner, 1870), William Maccall's Treatise on Politics (Holyoake, 1854), George Stuart Fullerton's Philosophy of Spinoza (Ethics I, II, V and extracts from III-IV; Holt, 2nd ed., 1894), Halbert Hains Britan's Principles of Descartes' Philosophy (Open Court, 1905), and A. Wolf's Short Treatise on God, Man and his Well-Being (A. and C. Black, 1910). All US public domain (published before 1930). Not taken: Hale White's Tractatus de Intellectus Emendatione (Fisher Unwin; the scan prints no year), and the 1888 Van Nostrand Ethics (no translator named in the book). No uids minted.
